name: Wärtsilä
needs: Engine/fuel decarbonisation (ammonia, methanol, hydrogen), vessel energy efficiency, digital ship ops, voyage optimisation, emissions monitoring.
why_partner: Global marine tech leader with large Finnish R&D (Vaasa, Helsinki); pilot vessels & customer base.

name: Kongsberg Maritime / Kongsberg Discovery
needs: Autonomy, underwater robotics, sensors, ocean data & MRV.
why_partner: Leading in AUVs, sensors, ocean observation; frequent acquirer of ocean-tech startups.

name: Meyer Turku (shipyard)
needs: Cruise ship energy efficiency, sustainable materials & interiors, waste/water systems onboard, digital shipbuilding.
why_partner: Turku's flagship shipyard; large supplier network; local to A'Pelago.

name: ABB Marine & Ports
needs: Electrification & propulsion (Azipod, Helsinki), shore power, port electrification, remote ops.
why_partner: Azipod HQ in Helsinki; strong pilot capability.

name: Viking Line
needs: Fuel/emission reduction, onboard waste & water, passenger experience; Baltic ferry testbed.
why_partner: A'Pelago partner; Turku–Stockholm route = ideal real-world test environment (TRL 6–7).

name: Finnlines
needs: Ro-pax decarbonisation, energy efficiency, cargo logistics.
why_partner: Baltic ro-pax operator (Grimaldi group).

name: Meriaura Group
needs: Low-emission short-sea shipping, bio-fuels, project logistics for offshore wind.
why_partner: Turku-based; LP in Redstone Blue → warm intro path.

name: Port of Turku
needs: Port emissions, shore power, smart port operations, water quality monitoring.
why_partner: Local testbed next to A'Pelago/Blue Economy Centre.

name: Port of Helsinki
needs: Carbon-neutral port target, shore power, smart logistics, pilots.
why_partner: Busy passenger port; links to Helsinki Blue Economy Studio.

name: Elomatic
needs: Engineering & ship design consultancy; integrates new tech into vessel designs.
why_partner: A'Pelago partner; channel into shipowners & yards.

name: Deltamarin
needs: Ship design & engineering (Turku/Raisio).
why_partner: Design-stage integration of green tech.

name: Kemira
needs: Water treatment chemicals & digital water solutions, nutrient recovery.
why_partner: Global water-chemistry company; natural partner for wastewater/nutrient startups.

name: HSY – Helsinki Region Environmental Services
needs: Wastewater treatment (Viikinmäki, Blominmäki), nutrient & micropollutant removal, monitoring.
why_partner: Large utility pilots water tech.

name: Neste
needs: Renewable marine fuels, waste & residue feedstocks.
why_partner: Feedstock/fuel partner for circular & marine fuel startups.

name: Raisio / Raisioaqua
needs: Sustainable fish feed ingredients (incl. Baltic fish & algae based), fish health.
why_partner: Finnish aquafeed producer near Turku.

name: Mowi
needs: Fish welfare, sea lice, monitoring, feed, low-impact farming.
why_partner: World's largest salmon farmer; runs innovation pilots.

name: BioMar
needs: Novel feed ingredients (algae, insects, single-cell protein), circular feed.
why_partner: Feed majors are key offtakers for marine ingredient startups.

name: DNV
needs: Classification, technology qualification, verification.
why_partner: Technology qualification/class approval is the gate to TRL 8 for maritime hardware.

name: Bureau Veritas
needs: Class approval, certification.
why_partner: A'Pelago partner (Veritas logo) — certification pathway.

name: A.P. Moller-Maersk
needs: Green fuels, logistics decarbonisation, digital supply chain.
why_partner: Pilot + CVC (Maersk Growth).

name: Equinor
needs: Offshore wind O&M, subsea inspection, environmental monitoring.
why_partner: Offshore operator + CVC.

name: Ørsted
needs: Offshore wind biodiversity (nature-inclusive design), inspection, monitoring.
why_partner: Biodiversity-positive offshore wind commitments → restoration startups.

name: Åbo Akademi University – Environmental & Marine Biology
needs: Applied research partners, data, field sites (Husö biological station, Åland/Archipelago Sea).
why_partner: Hosts Blue Economy Centre (Astra); A'Pelago partner.

name: University of Turku – Archipelago Research Institute (Seili)
needs: Long-term Archipelago Sea monitoring, field testing.
why_partner: Field station on Seili island — real-environment test site (TRL 5–7).

name: Finnish Environment Institute (Syke) – Marine Research Centre
needs: Baltic monitoring, eutrophication, environmental data, impact validation.
why_partner: Third-party impact validation (OIRL 7→8) & data.

name: Natural Resources Institute Finland (Luke)
needs: Aquaculture, fisheries & bioeconomy research; RAS test facilities.
why_partner: A'Pelago partner; aquaculture pilot facilities.

name: VTT Technical Research Centre of Finland
needs: Applied R&D, scale-up piloting (bio, materials, sensors, maritime).
why_partner: Pilot plants & tech scale-up; co-applicant in EU calls.

name: Aalto University – Marine Technology
needs: Ship design, ice, autonomy research; ice tank testing.
why_partner: Test facilities for maritime hardware (TRL 4–5).

name: Novia University of Applied Sciences
needs: Aquaculture & maritime applied research (Turku, Åboland).
why_partner: A'Pelago partner.

name: Turku University of Applied Sciences
needs: Applied research, student projects, testbeds.
why_partner: A'Pelago partner.

name: Finnish Meteorological Institute – Marine Research
needs: Ocean/ice/weather data, observation infrastructure (Argo, Utö station).
why_partner: Data & validation for marine intelligence startups.

name: SINTEF Ocean
needs: Ocean lab basin, aquaculture & ship testing.
why_partner: Large-scale test facilities; strong EU consortium partner.

name: DTU Aqua
needs: Aquaculture & fisheries research.
why_partner: Nordic research partner for aquaculture validation.

name: One Sea – Autonomous Maritime Ecosystem
needs: Autonomous shipping ecosystem; members include major maritime corporates.
why_partner: Access to autonomy pilots & corporates.

name: Business Turku / Blue Economy Centre
needs: Regional development, soft-landing, investor intros.
why_partner: A'Pelago partner; Turku blue economy hub.

name: John Nurminen Foundation
needs: Baltic Sea nutrient reduction & hazardous-substance projects.

name: Baltic Sea Action Group (BSAG)

why_partner: Connects startups with committed corporates.

name: HELCOM (Baltic Marine Environment Protection Commission)

why_partner: Policy alignment; BSAP targets as impact baseline.

name: 1000 Ocean Startups coalition
needs: Global ocean innovation network; Ocean Impact Navigator.
why_partner: Network of accelerators/investors; impact framework visibility.

name: NCE Seafood Innovation (Norway)
needs: Seafood cluster; access to Norwegian aquaculture companies.
why_partner: Gateway to Norway's seafood industry.

name: GCE Ocean Technology (Bergen)
needs: Ocean tech cluster; test arenas.
why_partner: Norwegian ocean-tech cluster & Ocean Tech Campus.

name: PwC Finland
needs: Due diligence, grant/funding advisory, ESG/impact assurance.
why_partner: A'Pelago partner; PwC Luxembourg runs BlueInvest — investor-readiness link.
